{{Quote|Feel the fire, like flowing water, like paint. Use fingers in your mind to draw it into different shapes. Swirl it around. You'll get the feel of it.|Brakiss, to Zekk|<ref name="TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>}}
'''Pyrokinesis''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to manipulate or generate fire or fiery energy<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> by rubbing [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] molecules together, producing heat through friction,<ref name="TCS">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> or controlling existing fires.<ref name="DARTH" />

The power could be used to manipulate and generate fire. In general, a force user typically manipulated fire from an already existing material, though a variant in which a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] conjured flames from the sky was known and considered to overlap with [[Alter Environment]].<ref name="TJP" /> [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] exemplified this, being famed for his ability to trigger fires by manipulating the molecules of combustible objects.<ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] also demonstrated the ability to generate fire, as shown when she lit several candles through the Force&mdash;commenting that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had taught her how to do so.<ref name="CHILD">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> Her twin children, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], learned to use create some kind of "flame-toy" while being held prisoner on the [[worldcraft]] ''[[Rebirth]]''. <ref name="TCS" /> [[Brakiss]] appeared to be a master of pyrokinesis, able to make flames dance as well as form different shapes as part of "amusing effects". He encouraged [[Zekk]] to try it out after activating a [[flare stick]], and the boy made such an impressive start that Brakiss recommended he practice further.<ref name="TLO" />

In manipulation, a Force user was capable of directing and controlling an already existing flame with relative ease. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used the ability to kill [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]], by coaxing a gentle flame from a gas powered fireplace into a raging inferno.<ref name="DARTH">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Although not directly seen doing so, a dream that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] had Sidious creating a wall of fire separating Vader from his son, Luke Skywalker, after revealing his survival.<ref name="TRATODV">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Knol Ven'nari]] was so proficient in this ability that she was capable of controlling and redirecting an explosion, something that she did in order to save her friends, though at the cost of her life.<ref name="BLAST">[[Republic 53|''Republic'' 53]]</ref> [[Galen Marek]] evoked a firestorm at the end of his life, annihilating the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] attacking his allies and staggering Darths Sidious and Vader a moment before his body died.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' {{C|novelization}}]]</ref>

The power was neutral in nature, with both Jedi and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] showing ability in its use.<ref name="CHILD" /><ref name="DARTH" /> Even other Force traditions, such as the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] and [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], were known to use the ability. This was shown by [[Dresdema]] when she attempted to cast a spell of flame against attacking Sith.<ref name="SISTER">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used this power to make surrounding flames part and create a path she could pass by without any injury, then let them reunite as she prepared to [[Duel on Yavin 4|fight]] Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="CW17">{{CW|17}}</ref> [[Teneniel Djo]] once used this to protect herself from incoming fire during the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], though she had only been partly successful.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> [[Vonnda Ra]] demonstrated this power on a lit [[Lantern/Legends|lantern]], prompting [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to replicate the feat, if not outdo the Nightsister, in order to infiltrate the [[Shadow Academy]].<ref name="SA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>

Some dark side Force ghosts could use a freezing fire, killing victims they "touched", then condemning them to eternal spectral torment.<ref>''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
